WITH patient_labs AS (
  SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) as avg_HGB, AVG(HCT) as avg_HCT 
  FROM Laboratory 
  WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL 
  GROUP BY ID
), 
patient_ratios AS (
  SELECT ID, CAST(avg_HGB AS REAL) / CAST(avg_HCT AS REAL) as ratio 
  FROM patient_labs
), 
overall_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) as overall_avg_ratio 
  FROM patient_ratios
),
above_overall AS (
  SELECT pr.ID, pr.ratio, pr.ratio - os.overall_avg_ratio as above_overall_amount 
  FROM patient_ratios pr, overall_stats os 
  WHERE pr.ratio > os.overall_avg_ratio
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) as group_avg_ratio 
  FROM above_overall
),
final_group AS (
  SELECT ao.ID, ao.ratio, ao.above_overall_amount, ao.ratio - gs.group_avg_ratio as above_group_amount 
  FROM above_overall ao, group_stats gs 
  WHERE ao.ratio > gs.group_avg_ratio
)
SELECT 
  AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio,
  AVG(above_overall_amount) as avg_above_overall,
  AVG(above_group_amount) as avg_above_group
FROM final_group
